NBN Ascension.kicker: NBN's floating resort under the Beanstalk
text: The NBN Ascension is a 362-metre resort ship. It lies at anchor in the bay off Esmeraldas, where its guests watch the Beanstalk cars climb from a pool deck. Haas-Bioroid hospitality units crew it, and NBN broadcasts three reality shows from its decks.

Two cabin towers frame a garden canyon, and a holo ring turns over the stack all night. Tenders run guests to the Esmeraldas quays at all hours. Crews come aboard to steal from risties, to lift NBN footage from the broadcast core, or to meet someone who will not set foot ashore.
